criteria.text: Events admitted after a flush boundary do not extend its target; a full event queue cannot drop its flush request or prevent a finite timeout result.
Cancelled waits throw OperationCanceledException without erasing shared coordination; repeated cancelled/timed-out calls do not accumulate unbounded worker controls or retained waiters.

Results accurately distinguish Completed/TimedOut, Succeeded, LossObserved, terminal counts, pending gauges, and initial global-invalid/rejection observations; successful drain can coexist with earlier observed rejection.
UTC clock changes do not alter the elapsed deadline; writer flush remains serialized with writes and is documented as userspace flushing, not fsync or collector acknowledgment.

portable: Fixed accepted targets, original facts, finite monotonic waits, caller-only cancellation, serialized writer operations and bounded shared coordination are portable semantic expectations.
